statistic, p_value = shapiro(per_dem_data)

# Determine normality status based on p-value
alpha = 0.05
if p_value < alpha:
    normality_status = "not normal"
    print(f"\nConclusion: Since p-value ({p_value:.10f}) < alpha ({alpha}),")
    print("we REJECT the null hypothesis.")
    print("The data is NOT normally distributed.")
else:
    normality_status = "normal"
    print(f"\nConclusion: Since p-value ({p_value:.10f}) >= alpha ({alpha}),")
    print("we FAIL TO REJECT the null hypothesis.")
    print("The data is normally distributed.")

print(f"\nNormality Status: {normality_status}")
